answer_result.answer: The evidence shows Calvin and Dave plan to meet in Boston, but it does not state the country.

question.question: Which country do Calvin and Dave want to meet in?

evidence_items.text:
Dave: Hey Calvin! Haven't talked in a while! Last Friday I had a card-night with my friends, it was so much fun. We laughed and had a great time! Take a look at the photo!
[Image caption: a photography of a group of men sitting at a table with playing cards]
[S15T1] (dia_id: D15:1)

Calvin: Hey Dave! Great to hear from you, card night sounds like a blast! Always love having fun with friends. Guess what? I scored a deal to continue collaboration with Frank Ocean! This is a dream come true for me, I've been working hard and it's finally paying off. No words can describe how happy I am.
[S15T2] (dia_id: D15:2)

Dave: Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you. How did this chance come up?
[S15T3] (dia_id: D15:3)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I had the opportunity to meet Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and we clicked. We've been speaking and sharing ideas we arranged a meeting and recorded a song in the studio at my mansion - it's been great!
[S15T4] (dia_id: D15:4)

Dave: Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!
[S15T5] (dia_id: D15:5)

Calvin: It was an incredible experience, Dave! The city was buzzing with energy and the festival crowd was so lively - it was like fuel for my soul. Look at this photo, that's amazing!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people sitting on the grass at night]
[S15T6] (dia_id: D15:6)

Dave: Wow, that sounds incredible! What was it like playing at the festival? Must have been an amazing experience.
[S15T7] (dia_id: D15:7)

Calvin: It was a dream come true, Dave! The festival had buzzing energy and a super upbeat crowd. We all felt connected, it was amazing!
[S15T8] (dia_id: D15:8)

Dave: Sounds like you had a blast! Did any other collaborations come out of that performance? Any upcoming concerts we should know about?
[S15T9] (dia_id: D15:9)

Calvin: Yeah Dave, someone even noticed my performance and now we're working together, which is wild. My tour ends soon and I'm heading to Boston. Maybe we can meet up then!
[S15T10] (dia_id: D15:10)

Dave: Sounds great! Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!
[S15T11] (dia_id: D15:11)

Calvin: Of course, Dave can't wait to catch up! I almost forgot, yesterday my friends and I recorded a podcast where we discuss the rapidly evolving rap industry!
[S15T12] (dia_id: D15:12)

Dave: That sounds fantastic! I'm looking forward to listening to your podcast and learning more about the rap industry. Keep up the great work!
[S15T13] (dia_id: D15:13)

Calvin: I'll let you know when the podcast will be uploaded. Take care!
[S15T14] (dia_id: D15:14)

Dave: Sure, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing about it. See ya then!
[S15T15] (dia_id: D15:15)

- Friend/acquaintance of Dave; their 2023-03-23 exchange included "nice to meet you" greetings alongside references to prior talks [S1T1].
- On 2023-03-26, Dave congratulated him on the new car [S2T2][S2T6].
- On 2023-04-20, reconnected with Dave ("long time no see") and updated him on the Tokyo music festival; Dave reacted positively and asked where he sees his music going [S3T1][S3T2][S3T8].
- On 2023-04-20, Dave offered to show him around Boston and take him to his favorite food spots; Calvin proposed meeting up for a meal when he is in Boston (details in the Boston trip section above) [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16].
- The 2023-04-20 conversation closed with both of them looking forward to the visit — Calvin said he can't wait to try the food with Dave, and Dave replied he can't wait to show Calvin the amazing music and food in Boston, signing off "See you soon!" [S3T17][S3T18].
- On 2023-05-01, congratulated Dave on opening his own car maintenance shop — "Congrats on achieving your dream", said his hard work and dedication paid off, praised Dave's "guts and ambition" and told him to "keep it up", was enthusiastic about Dave going after classic cars ("Fulfilling your dreams is so important"), and called the photo of the restored car's engine "awesome" (details on Dave's shop in /memories/dave.md > ## Car maintenance shop) [S4T2][S4T4][S4T6][S4T8].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Nice to meet you! How's it going since we talked?
[S1T1] (dia_id: D1:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin! Nice to meet you too! Things have been going well since we last talked. I attended this awesome event recently. It was like a car lover's paradise! They had so many classic cars on show, I was in awe. I even had the opportunity to speak with some of the owners and hear their fascinating stories. It was super inspiring. What about you? Anything exciting happening in your life lately?
[S1T2] (dia_id: D1:2)

Calvin: That event sounds great! Something really exciting happened to me - I just had a big life change! Here's my new mansion - pretty cool huh?
[Image caption: a photo of a building with a sign on the front of it]
[S1T3] (dia_id: D1:3)

Dave: Wow! Congrats on the big change! What inspired you to start this journey?
[S1T4] (dia_id: D1:4)

Calvin: I'm so excited to learn about Japanese culture and get a chance to expand.
[S1T5] (dia_id: D1:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, learning about new cultures is awesome! Have you ever been to Japan?
[S1T6] (dia_id: D1:6)

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- As of 2023-05-31, the Boston visit is part of the Frank Ocean tour: "Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank!" — he's "buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like" and "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (calling Boston's folks "from home" suggests it is where he's from, though not stated outright). He asked Dave what he thinks of the music scene there; Dave: it's "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play," and he'll be there to cheer Calvin on (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S7T15][S7T16].
- On 2023-06-09, said he has never been to Boston before but has heard the parks are amazing — "can't wait to visit next month" (i.e., July 2023); he wants to take walks in the Boston parks to experience their serenity and recharge, and asked Dave what cool things he remembers about them; shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers (likely from the album session); Dave's recollections of the Boston parks are in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston [S8T5][S8T7].
- As of 2023-08-22, said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, and proposed meeting up with Dave then — "Maybe we can meet up then!" (renewing the earlier plan to meet in Boston, see above); Dave: "Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Note: the 2023-08-14 update described the Frank Ocean tour as already having ended with the Tokyo show, so this "tour ends soon" may be a continuation or a new tour — unconfirmed) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-02, told Dave he booked a flight to Boston "last week" (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming Boston trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it — "See you soon, buddy!"; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (continuing the plan to meet up in Boston, see above) [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!"; Calvin thanked Dave, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].
- On 2023-09-13, re-pledged the plan to let Dave know when he's in Boston — "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston" — and accepted Dave's offer to check out his garage and its cool cars (Dave shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), saying it would be fun and might give him ideas for future projects (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S18T11][S18T12].

Calvin: Yeah, hard work and dedication are definitely key to reaching our goals and potential. It's awesome to see our growth and progress.
[S21T13] (dia_id: D21:13)

Dave: Yeah, it's great to see our progress. It's really motivating and keeps me pushing for more.
[S21T14] (dia_id: D21:14)

Calvin: Agreed, Dave! Progress is what keeps us motivated and pushing for more. Let's never give up and keep striving for success. We know that hard work and determination matter, and it's what sets us apart. Onwards to our goals!
[S21T15] (dia_id: D21:15)

Dave: Let's keep going! We won't lose focus on our goals. Hard work and determination will get us there. Let's do this!
[S21T16] (dia_id: D21:16)

Calvin: Yeah, let's do it! Let's stay focused and work hard to make our dreams happen. We can make it happen together! Wishing you all the best until we meet again!




 
[S21T17] (dia_id: D21:17)

Dave: Yep, Calvin! Together, we can do amazing things if we work together and stay motivated. We got this! Take care and stay well!
[S21T18] (dia_id: D21:18)

- The 2023-08-14 conversation closed with Calvin cheering Dave on: "You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you. Seeing your enthusiasm is amazing. Keep growing, buddy. It'll be worth it! Good luck with that. See ya!" [S14T16].
- On 2023-08-22, reconnected with Dave ("Haven't talked in a while!"): Dave shared that he'd had a card night with friends; Calvin told Dave he scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean (details in ## Frank Ocean collaboration) — Dave: "Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you." and asked how the chance came up; Calvin explained he met Frank at a Tokyo music festival, they clicked, and they recorded a song in his mansion studio; Dave: "Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!" and asked what it was like playing at the festival; Calvin described the buzzing energy, the lively crowd, and feeling connected with everyone, and shared a photo of the crowd on the grass [S15T1][S15T2][S15T3][S15T4][S15T5][S15T6][S15T7][S15T8] (Dave's card-night details in /memories/dave.md > ## Card night (2023-08-18))
- The 2023-08-22 conversation continued: Dave asked whether any other collaborations came out of the performance and about upcoming concerts; Calvin: "Yeah Dave, someone even noticed my performance and now we're working together, which is wild. My tour ends soon and I'm heading to Boston. Maybe we can meet up then!" (collaborator and tour details in ## Music and ## Boston trip); Dave agreed to meet up when Calvin is in Boston and asked for the details when he has them; Calvin then almost-reminded himself and told Dave that on 2023-08-21 he and his friends recorded a podcast about the rap industry (details in ## Podcast (2023-08-21)); Dave said he was looking forward to listening and to learning more about the rap industry, "Keep up the great work!"; Calvin said he'd let Dave know when the podcast will be uploaded, "Take care!"; Dave: "Sure, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing about it. See ya then!" [S15T9][S15T10][S15T11][S15T12][S15T13][S15T14][S15T15].
- On 2023-08-31, reconnected with Dave ("Long time no chat!"): Dave asked how the end of the tour was ("I bet it was amazing!"), and Calvin said the tour was amazing — he was "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — sharing a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen ("This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!"); Dave asked how it was performing on that big stage, and Calvin said it was "a dream come true", he "felt on top of the world", and it was "seriously surreal"; Dave: "Wow, that must have been an incredible experience! Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!"; Calvin then said he'd started shooting a video for his new album the weekend before (~2023-08-25/26) — "can't wait for you to check it out!" — and shared a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach ("Look how great it was!"); Dave: "Can't wait to see it", and asked whether it will be shot on location; Calvin: the shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach — "It's going to have some epic visuals!" (details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20) and ## Music video (Miami, 2023-08-31)) [S16T1][S16T2][S16T3][S16T4][S16T5][S16T6][S16T7][S16T8].
- On 2023-09-02, reconnected with Dave ("Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up?"): Dave said he's been tied up with car stuff and had just come back from San Francisco with great insights on car modification (details in the Car workshops in San Francisco section of /memories/dave.md), and that fixing things gives him a sense of purpose and pride (details in the Hobbies and sense of purpose section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin understood the satisfaction of giving things a new life ("It's like you're giving them new life"), and said Dave must feel great making a real difference in someone's life — "like being their superhero!" — and that he should be proud of bringing joy to others [S17T1][S17T2][S17T3][S17T4][S17T5]. Calvin then told Dave he booked a flight to Boston last week (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is so excited about the upcoming trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it (details in ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)); Dave: "Let me know when you're free and we can catch up in Boston."; Calvin: he'll let him know when he's in Boston, and they signed off "See you soon!" [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The 2023-09-02 chat then closed: Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!", and Calvin thanked him, told Dave to stay safe on the trip, said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].

Calvin: Wow, Boston looks great! Thanks for the tips. And, awesome pic!
[S3T11] (dia_id: D3:11)

Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!
[Image caption: a photography of a green mustang parked in a field of grass]
[S3T12] (dia_id: D3:12)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that car looks great! Take a look at my car, I put a lot of work into it. Can't wait to see more when I'm in Boston!
[Image caption: a photo of a red sports car on display at a show]
[S3T13] (dia_id: D3:13)

Dave: Thanks! It definitely took a lot of work. Have you had a chance to check out Boston apart from the gigs?
[S3T14] (dia_id: D3:14)

Calvin: Not yet, been pretty busy with rehearsals and traveling. But I'm looking forward to exploring the city, trying out some delicious food, and visiting the popular attractions. Maybe we can grab a bite together when I'm there?
[S3T15] (dia_id: D3:15)

Dave: Definitely, Cal! Let's grab some food and I'll show you my favorite spots in the city. Can't wait to show them to you!
[S3T16] (dia_id: D3:16)

Calvin: Sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to try out the food there with you. It'll be fun!
[S3T17] (dia_id: D3:17)

Dave: It'll be great, Cal! Can't wait to show you the amazing music and food here. See you soon!
[S3T18] (dia_id: D3:18)

- On 2023-05-31, said Boston's music scene is "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play"; Calvin is "buzzing" to perform there, and Dave says it "will be a blast" and that he'll be there to cheer Calvin on. Calvin's Boston show is now a stop on the Frank Ocean tour — details in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md [S7T15][S7T16].
- As of 2023-06-09, says the Boston parks are "awesome, especially in spring" — "it's so serene when you're walking around" — and went for a stroll in one on 2023-06-02 (last Friday), which was "amazing ... magical"; he bet Calvin will love it [S8T6].
- On 2023-08-22, Calvin said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, proposing they meet up then (renewing the plan for Dave to show Calvin around, see above); Dave: "Sounds great! Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Calvin's side in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-13, when Calvin got excited about his tour spots, said live music is the best, was sure Calvin would have a blast on tour and make awesome memories, and offered to show Calvin around his garage and its cool cars — "If you ever want to check out my garage and see some cool cars, I'd love to show you around. Keep rockin'!" (renewing his long-standing offer to show Calvin some cars when he comes to Boston, see ## Classic cars); shared a photo of his garage (a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign) — "Check out pic of my garage, it looks stunning!" — and said "Can't wait for your visit!"; Calvin accepted the offer ("I'll definitely take you up on that offer") and re-pledged to let Dave know when he's in Boston (Calvin's side in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md) [S18T10][S18T11][S18T12].
- On 2023-11-17, when Calvin announced he's accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston (details in the Music section of this file and in ## Music of /memories/calvin.md), said "Wow, Calvin! That's amazing news! Congratulations on both the gala attendance and the upcoming performance. I can't wait to hear all about it and maybe even catch one of your shows in Boston. Let me know when you're free to catch up. Cheers to your musical journey!"; Calvin: "Thanks, Dave! I'll catch you when I'm in Boston. Cheers!" — and the chat closed with mutual goodbyes — Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you. Stay safe, talk to you soon!" and Calvin: "Thanks! You too. Talk to you later!" [S30T20][S30T21][S30T22][S30T23][S30T24].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Met with the creative team for my album yesterday. It was a long session, but awesome to see everything coming together. 
[S8T1] (dia_id: D8:1)

Dave: Hey Cal! Sounds great that your album's coming along. Are you feeling good about it? Here's a pic I just took.
[Image caption: a photography of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees]
[S8T2] (dia_id: D8:2)

Calvin: Dave, thanks for checking in. I'm feeling stoked about this album! We've been making some magic with a team in the studio, working on the music and everything. Look at what a wonderful studio we have! How have you been? Anything new since we talked?
[Image caption: a photo of a recording studio with a large window and a desk]
[S8T3] (dia_id: D8:3)

Dave: Hey, nice photo of the studio! Working in a team yields incredible results, well done! Keep pushing it! I've been doing good - thanks for asking. I've been exploring some parks on the weekends to relax - it's so peaceful being surrounded by nature. Are there any chill spots you enjoy in Boston?
[S8T4] (dia_id: D8:4)

Calvin: Thanks! That studio is great for creativity. I've never been to Boston before, but I hear the parks are amazing. Can't wait to visit next month. Anything cool you remember about Boston parks?
[Image caption: a photo of a tree with pink flowers in the foreground]
[S8T5] (dia_id: D8:5)

Dave: That sounds great! The Boston parks are awesome, especially in spring. It's so serene when you're walking around. I went for a stroll last Friday and it was amazing. It's so magical - I bet you'll love it! I love taking walks on the weekends, they recharge me for the entire upcoming week!
[S8T6] (dia_id: D8:6)

Calvin: I'm excited to experience that serenity. I can't wait to take a walk in the parks and recharge. Hey, have you been on any hikes lately?
[Image caption: a photo of a path going up a hill with a view of the mountains]
[S8T7] (dia_id: D8:7)

Dave: Nah, haven't gone hiking recently, but it's awesome - being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights. Clears your mind and brings a sense of calm. Have you been to the mountains before? Heard they're super chill.
[S8T8] (dia_id: D8:8)

Calvin: Nah, haven't been to the mountains but I'm keen to go. Looking for a way to escape it all and de-stress. I want to go on a hike to a place similar to this. What's new and exciting happening for you, Dave?
[Image caption: a photo of a plane flying over a mountain range with snow on the top]
[S8T9] (dia_id: D8:9)

Dave: I booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month! Finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks! Gonna be an amazing experience!
[S8T10] (dia_id: D8:10)

Calvin: Cool, Dave! Have a great time. I'm sure it's going to be an amazing experience. Take lots of pics and show me when you get back.
[S8T11] (dia_id: D8:11)

Dave: Yep, Calvin! Gonna take lots of pics. Can't wait to show you when I get back!
[S8T12] (dia_id: D8:12)

Calvin: Have fun exploring the mountains, Dave! Safe travels and see you soon. Take care!
[S8T13] (dia_id: D8:13)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Take care, see you soon!
[S8T14] (dia_id: D8:14)

- On 2023-11-13, said he's "stoked [he] made a difference" — "paying it forward" — and that working with new talent brings new ideas to his work; shared a photo of himself making a beat for a young artist (a photo of a man sitting at a desk in front of a computer), saying the artist has great potential in music (Dave: "Wow, that's cool! Your music studio looks great.") [S29T13].
- On 2023-11-17, told Dave (when asked who he had the most interesting chat with at the fancy Boston gala he attended the day before, 2023-11-16): he had a really interesting conversation with "this cool artist" — "we clicked over music and art" — and they talked about their favorite artists, art, and "how the power of music connects us all"; "It was such an inspiring conversation - I feel like I'm on a creative high." — and shared a photo of the two of them sitting on a bench in the snow (a photo of the artist, not previously named or identified) [S30T4]. Dave: "That's amazing, Calvin! Music really does bring people together and foster creativity. Glad to hear you had such an inspiring conversation!" (Dave's side in the Music section of /memories/dave.md; conversation flow in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Relationships) [S30T5].
- On 2023-11-17 (later in the same chat with Dave, after sharing his Japanese-garden photo), announced more great news: he's accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston — "It's going to be an unforgettable musical experience!" — and he'll fill Dave in on all the details later (a Boston show on top of his other Boston activity, e.g., the 2023-11-16 gala and the 2023-11-13 Boston performance, see ## Boston trip); Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's amazing news! Congratulations on both the gala attendance and the upcoming performance. I can't wait to hear all about it and maybe even catch one of your shows in Boston." (Calvin's side of the closing exchange in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Relationships; Dave's side in the Music, Photography, and Relationships sections of /memories/dave.md) [S30T20].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Long time no talk! I had a great time yesterday, and visited some sights in Boston with a high school friend. It was really fun and eye-opening.
[S26T1] (dia_id: D26:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin! Good to hear from you! Sounds like you had a blast in Boston - so much to do there! One of my favorites there is great for chilling and admiring nature. BTW, something cool I wanted to tell you about - I recently attended a conference in Detroit - it was so cool, I learned a lot.
[S26T2] (dia_id: D26:2)

Calvin: I had a wonderful experience during my time in Boston. It had awesome architecture and a really cool history. I followed your advice and went there, it was so peaceful. Good to hear that you've learned a lot of new things at the conference in Detroit!
[S26T3] (dia_id: D26:3)

Dave: Glad you enjoyed Boston! It's got some great architecture and history. Working on this takes me out of my head and calms me down. Here's a pic of my latest car project.
[Image caption: a photography of a group of people washing a car in a garage]
[S26T4] (dia_id: D26:4)

Calvin: Dave, that car looks awesome! What got you into engineering cars? I'm totally into cars too and love making new and powerful models.
[S26T5] (dia_id: D26:5)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It's always been my thing. My dad took me to my first car show when I was 10, and I was wow-ed! I was hooked and wanted to learn more. Now I'm an automotive engineer and it's crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts.
[S26T6] (dia_id: D26:6)

- When Calvin recognized the clock tower ("In your last photo, is that the clock tower?"), Dave confirmed it is the clock tower — he snapped it at sunset and the colors were stunning [S27T7][S27T8].
- On 2023-10-29, said photography helps him capture and appreciate the beauty of nature — "It's been an awesome creative outlet and I'm loving it." (his appreciation of nature echoes his park walks — see ## Parks; Calvin: "You're so talented, Dave!", to which Dave said "Thanks, Calvin! Your kind words mean a lot.") (Calvin's side in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S27T8].
- On 2023-10-25, when Calvin told him he'd enjoyed sightseeing in Boston the day before (2023-10-24), said Boston has "so much to do" and mentioned one of his favorites there that is "great for chilling and admiring nature" (consistent with his Boston-parks remarks, see above and ## Parks); Calvin: "I followed your advice and went there, it was so peaceful." [S26T2][S26T3].

Calvin: Thanks Dave! Lots of cool stuff happening. Next up, a tour - so excited! After that, I'm off to explore and grow my brand. Can't wait to see what the future has in store!
[S18T7] (dia_id: D18:7)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Congrats on the upcoming tour! Can't wait to see you perform. Do you have any cities or venues in mind?
[S18T8] (dia_id: D18:8)

Calvin: Yay! Dave! We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!
[S18T9] (dia_id: D18:9)

Dave: That sounds awesome, Calvin! Live music is the best. I'm sure you're gonna have a blast on tour and make some awesome memories. If you ever want to check out my garage and see some cool cars, I'd love to show you around. Keep rockin'!
[S18T10] (dia_id: D18:10)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'll definitely take you up on that offer. It would be fun to check out your garage and maybe even get some ideas for future projects. I'll let you know when I'm in Boston. Keep pursuing your passions and keep those cars rolling. You rock!
[S18T11] (dia_id: D18:11)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Appreciate the kind words and support. Can't wait for your visit! Take care and keep creating amazing music! Check out pic of my garage, it looks stunning!
[Image caption: a photo of a car in a garage with a coca cola sign]
[S18T12] (dia_id: D18:12)

Calvin: Thanks! I can't wait for your visit either. Take care and keep enjoying your hobbies!
[S18T13] (dia_id: D18:13)

Dave: Sure thing! Thanks again for your help. Bye! Have a great day.
[S18T14] (dia_id: D18:14)

Calvin: No problem! Always good chatting with you. Have an awesome day!
[S18T15] (dia_id: D18:15)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Catch you later. Have a great day!
[S18T16] (dia_id: D18:16)
